subject: SOC2 coverage: snapshot cutoffs, log timestamps, and bridge letter logistics
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@baysidehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 period and snapshot inclusivity question

Hi Neha,

We're working through our vendor assessment for Bayside Health and had a quick clarification on Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials. The copy of the report we have lists the period as 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30. For our internal controls testing we need to confirm two things:

1) Are point-in-time snapshots taken at 00:00 UTC on the final day (e.g., 2026-06-30T00:00:00Z) considered inside the audit period for the purposes of evidence?
2) If a customer requests log exports for a specific day (e.g., all events with timestamps on 2026-04-30), what timezone conventions should we use — are logs stored with UTC timestamps and do you treat the day as inclusive of the midnight boundary?

Separately, our procurement team may need a bridge letter covering the period between the report end date and our contract start (looking for coverage through 2026-08-15). Is Redwood able to provide a standard bridge letter, and what's the expected turnaround?

Appreciate the quick confirmation.

Thanks,
Liam
Security Analyst
Bayside Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@baysidehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 period and snapshot inclusivity question

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, details below:

- Audit period: The SOC 2 Type II report covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30 inclusive. Our auditor's interpretation (and how we've presented evidence historically) treats end-of-day point-in-time snapshots taken at 00:00 UTC on the final day as within scope for that day.

- Log timestamps: Our production logs are stored with ISO8601 UTC timestamps (e.g., 2026-04-30T14:23:05Z). For day-level exports you should use UTC boundaries; an export for 2026-04-30 would include events where timestamp >= 2026-04-30T00:00:00Z and < 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z.

- Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter to cover the post-report window you mentioned (through 2026-08-15). I have attached the SOC 2 report PDF for your records and will circulate a draft bridge letter for your review. Typical turnaround for an internal redline + DocuSign is 48–72 hours once wording is agreed.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf)

I'll loop in Marissa from our Compliance team to help draft the letter and Karthik from Sales to handle any procurement gating. If you need any point-in-time evidence samples (e.g., a single-day log export or a sampling manifest) tell me which dates and we'll generate a sanitized sample.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@baysidehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 period and snapshot inclusivity question

Thanks Neha — that helps. Two quick follow-ups before we proceed to a bridge:

1) Could you produce a one-day sanitized log export for 2026-04-30 (UTC) showing the timestamp field and a request-id or event-id for correlation? We only need a small sample (50–100 rows) with production timestamp formatting.
2) Can the bridge letter explicitly state that: (a) the SOC 2 report period is inclusive through 2026-06-30; (b) point-in-time snapshots at 00:00 UTC on period boundaries are considered in-scope; and (c) logs retain timezone-aware UTC timestamps?

If you can send the draft bridge letter and a sample manifest, we can turn around procurement sign-off within 48 hours.

Appreciate it.

Liam

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 period and snapshot inclusivity question — bridge letter & samples attached

Hi Liam —

Thanks — attached are the materials you requested:

1) Redwood_bridge_letter_draft_2027.docx — a draft bridge letter that includes the specific language you requested: (a) SOC 2 period inclusive through 2026-06-30; (b) point-in-time snapshots at 00:00 UTC on period boundaries are treated as in-scope; (c) logs are retained with UTC timestamps. Please review and mark any redlines.

2) logs_sampling_manifest_20270512.csv — a sanitized sample manifest for 2026-04-30 with timestamp and event_id columns (50 rows). The full unredacted export can be provided under an NDA/procurement-approved channel if needed.

We will send the finalized bridge letter via DocuSign once you confirm wording. Anticipated turnaround after confirmation is ~48 hours.

DocuSign link (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-bridge-letter
Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/redwood/reports/Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf

If you want Marissa to add auditor contact details or to include an explicit statement about evidence retention locations, let us know and we'll update the draft.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_bridge_letter_draft_2027.docx (docx), logs_sampling_manifest_20270512.csv (csv)
